headline: Second readings of policies on school facility fees, student allergies, and travel expense reimbursement.
summary: The agenda also includes updates on The Landing School, state testing, and a legislative reception. Several other policies are up for a second reading or a review and revision.
items: Consent agenda: nomination of Margaret Stewart as Human Resources Specialist, Leadership Office
Consent agenda: stipends and PLCSS mentor stipends
Consent agenda: appointments of Rosemarie Michaud as Bus Aide, and Kim Nadeau and Wassen Abd as Food Service Workers
Committee reports, including the Advisory Committee on Policy summary of the 10/14/2026 meeting
The Landing School and Biddeford Regional Center of Technology update
Legislative reception update, including the YCSA brochure
Second reading of policies to adopt: DKC travel expense reimbursement, KF-R school facilities fee schedule, and JLCEA students with diagnosed allergies and sensitivities

Second reading of policies to review or revise: JJIC-R athletics and extracurricular rules, KF community use of school facilities, BDB school committee officers, BEC executive sessions, BEC-R executive session law, BID school committee member compensation and expenses, DD grants, EBCA emergency management plan (2025), and EHB school records retention
location: Steve White Gym and BRCOT Dining Commons, Biddeford High School
